scope.rerasterize: All CJK unified ideographs used by the selected Chinese translations, plus every newly allocated character.
scope.preserve: Original kana, Latin glyphs, punctuation with an existing reachable glyph, control symbols, and glyphs outside the selected Chinese translations.

cjk_bbox_normalization.reason: Render every CJK ideograph from the same high-resolution Noto em, trim only quantization-invisible outer pixels, proportionally fit the visible raster inside a 22x22 box, and center it in the fixed 24x24 cell. Character-specific resizing, point sizes, and corrections are forbidden.
